ordinary_course_rules.when: course.name is not one of the consultation-package course names and userCourse.kolPersonalConsultations > 0
course.name is not one of the consultation-package course names and userCourse.kolGroupConsultations > 0

client_sync.missing_name_or_tg_username: Do not erase or degrade an existing name; report the missing source field.
client_sync.contact_conflict: Do not overwrite automatically; stop and report the conflicting YCLIENTS matches.

existing_client_rule: Never top up an existing subscription. If any subscription/card exists in complete YCLIENTS network history, skip the sale without changing the client. An existing client may receive a new subscription only after complete network history proves zero prior subscriptions; without that proof, stop for manual review.
existing_subscription_rule: Do not change balance or period. Skip and report existing subscription history.
exhausted_subscription_rule: Do not top up. Skip and report existing subscription history.
expired_subscription_rule: Do not change or issue automatically; skip and report existing subscription history.
multiple_exhausted_rule: Do not top up. Skip and report existing subscription history.
multiple_positive_balance_rule: Do not top up. Skip and report existing subscription history.
missing_subscription_rule: Issue the approved type only when complete network history proves the client has zero prior subscriptions. A missing matching type is not sufficient when any other card/subscription exists.

new_subscription_expiration.ordinary_types: Set expiration from userCourse.gracePeriodEndDate; if missing or not in the future, do nothing and report.
new_subscription_expiration.package_types: Do not set or change expiration; keep the validity configured in the YCLIENTS subscription type.
new_subscription_expiration.direct_command_without_sale: For ordinary types ask the user for expiration before writing; package types need no expiration input.

unknown_course_rule: Stop and report as an exception; never infer another YCLIENTS type.
conservative_exceptions: conflicting or multiple YCLIENTS client matches
source yclientsClientID conflicts with normalized phone or email
ordinary course with neither group nor personal quantity
existing client without complete proof of zero subscription history
